items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: He comes up and he says “you made the right decision.” I says “cool man.” And I shook his hand.

ctx.x: A funny anecdote is that about 25 years later I’m playing with Brubeck with the Buffalo Symphony. Sold out. In about the fifth row is — I forget his first name, but Rosenbaum, that was the coach, was in the fifth row. So afterwards I come out to get my horn stands, you know, and pick the stuff up off the stage like I usually do after a concert. He comes up and he says “you made the right decision.” I says “cool man.” And I shook his hand. I says “I know I did.”
That is a good story man.
